rationale: Measured current state (revision 07bfb8d, accepted barrier bundle installed): clean paired objective 36.281 ms (candidate endpoints 37.56/35.00 vs parent 44.52), step_ms 110.73/112.01 against the 121.51 ms limit (previous_feedback project_measurement). The step's NCCL kernel sum is exactly 13 fp32 SUM allreduces (d0938de87369efd500322679 x12 at 28,351,488 B; b8ade439d7b8bd5fb5c1029b x1 at 157,541,376 B; cross-rank matched seq 21-33). The non-waiting rank pays 32.65-32.79 ms (12x1.855-1.892 ms + 10.17-10.32 ms = ~15.0-15.3 GB/s per collective), which is the transport floor under current settings; the remaining 2.3-4.9 ms on the max rank is in-kernel waiting from post-barrier bucket-readiness skew (execution_timeline previous-after: CPU submit spread 0->0.75 ms then flat; discovery 'after' kernel waits are hook-perturbed, not clean timing). Transport evidence: NCCL 2.29.7 runs RING over SHM/direct through host with only 2 channels (nccl_tuning evidence jobs/nccl-tuning-970abcd3ff, Channel 00/02, 01/02), P2P peer access is unavailable (peer_access.0.1=peer_access.1.0=0), both GPUs are PCIe gen4 x16 (capability-pcie_link gen 4 width 16) across host bridges (topology NODE), and device telemetry sustains pcie.rx 14.5-14.7 GB/s during repeats - roughly half of gen4 x16 practical per-direction rate. The warmed collective_calibration at the same sizes under default tuning (RING SIMPLE, 2ch) is 12x1.977+10.587 = 34.3 ms, slower than the in-model RING_LL kernels (14.3 vs 15.2 GB/s), so the floor is channel/protocol limited rather than interconnect saturated; the collection plan explicitly left 'interconnect-limited vs protocol-limited' open with headroom. Why this boundary: the default PG's NCCL communicator is created in prepare() (DDP construction broadcast) before candidate build, so NCCL channel/protocol env can only act on a NEW communicator created by the candidate; routing the 13 bucket allreduces onto it requires a comm hook, and installing that hook is only coherent jointly with re-issuing the whole accumulated step verbatim (no_sync schedule, accepted pre-final-backward gloo barrier ce82ecddfc3cbcf0769cdf2b, optimizer.step+synchronize) as one replacement of project.invoke 5d7d6bb13691b02f533f62b0 (group 3c57c8731ec33ed76cbb); every observed call under that boundary is listed as affected. Feasibility precedent: torch 2.13 default_hooks.allreduce_hook (div by world size then SUM) is documented as behavior-preserving versus the default reducer and is exactly what the source's own inventory hook uses; the hook keeps DDP bucket timing and backward overlap, so step_ms risk is confined to one-time lazy process-group creation absorbed before measured repeats, and gradients stay bitwise identical across ranks (deterministic SUM on identical inputs). Rejected alternatives: further skew-only candidates (expected 2.3-4.9 ms) sit inside the last evaluation's MAD-derived noise bounds (0.44/4.10 ms) with no host-reachable sync point inside backward; consolidating buckets exposes ~33 ms of serialized communication and would exceed the 121.5 ms step limit; leaving NCCL entirely violates the required-NCCL-gradient-reduction invariant.
hypothesis: The 13 gradient allreduces currently run on the default 2-channel SHM communicator initialized in prepare(); a candidate-created NCCL process group initialized after build() under a raised NCCL_MAX_CHANNELS (8-16, with the protocol constrained to retain the measured LL advantage of 15.2 vs 14.3 GB/s over default SIMPLE at 28 MB), wired through a div-then-SUM comm hook on the DDP model, will raise per-collective effective bandwidth above the measured 15.0-15.3 GB/s floor, shrinking every ncclDevKernel_AllReduce duration; the max-rank kernel-sum objective should drop from 36.28 ms in proportion to the bandwidth gain (497.8 MB total, ~2.1 ms per GB/s) while the preserved barrier holds the residual wait at or below the current 2.3-4.9 ms and step_ms stays within 121.5 ms. This is a hypothesis to be falsified by the paired AB/BA protocol: if channel count does not lift SHM bandwidth the gain should fall within noise and the candidate must not be accepted, and a concrete regression path - the new communicator silently selecting SIMPLE (floor 34.3 ms > current 32.7 ms) - must be checked from the profiled kernel names before any benefit is claimed.
